mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(a.user_id,0) AS user_id,COALESCE(a.item_id,0) AS item_id, COALESCE(a.ad_id,0) AS ad_id,COALESCE(a.advertiser_id,0) AS advertiser_id, COALESCE(a.treatment,false) AS treatment,COALESCE(a.propensity,0) AS propensity, COALESCE(a.pctr,0) AS pctr,COALESCE(a.pcvr,0) AS pcvr, COALESCE(a.quality,0) AS quality,COALESCE(a.relevance,0) AS relevance, COALESCE(a.bid,0) AS bid,a.assigned_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ad_conversion_fact f WHERE f.advertiser_id=a.advertiser_id AND f.user_id=a.user_id AND f.objective=#{objective} AND f.occurred_at>=a.assigned_at AND f.occurred_at<=a.outcome_due_at) AS outcome FROM ad_uplift_assignment a WHERE a.outcome_due_at<=#{asOf} AND a.assigned_at>=#{since} ORDER BY a.assigned_at,a.assignment_id
